description_en: Queries the supported character sets, collations, and other properties of a PolarDB database
description_zh: 查询PolarDB数据库支持的字符集、排序规则等属性
name: DescribeDBInitializeVariable

parameters.help_en:
The cluster ID.

Call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/98094.html operation to view information about all clusters in the destination region, including cluster IDs
parameters.help_zh:
集群ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/98094.html接口查看目标地域下的所有集群信息，包括集群ID

DBType.description_en:
The database type. Valid values:

Oracle

PostgreSQL

MySQL
DBType.description_zh:
数据库类型，取值如下：

Oracle
PostgreSQL
MySQL

Collate.description_en:
The locale setting that specifies the collation for a new database.

The locale must be compatible with the character set specified by the CharacterSetName parameter.

This parameter is required when the cluster is a PolarDB for PostgreSQL (Oracle Compatible) or PolarDB for PostgreSQL cluster.

To view the valid values for this parameter, log on to the PolarDB console, go to the Configuration and Management > Database Management tab, and click Create Database
Collate.description_zh:
语言环境设置，用于指定新建数据库的排序规则。

语言环境必须与CharacterSetName参数设置的字符集兼容。
当集群为PolarDB PostgreSQL版（兼容Oracle）或PolarDB PostgreSQL版时，该参数必填。

关于该参数的取值范围，请登录PolarDB控制台，在配置与管理 > 数据库管理页签，单击创建数据库进行查看

Ctype.description_en:
The locale setting that specifies the character classification for the database.

The locale must be compatible with the character set specified by the CharacterSetName parameter.

The value must be the same as the value of the Collate parameter.

This parameter is required when the cluster is a PolarDB for PostgreSQL (Oracle Compatible) or PolarDB for PostgreSQL cluster. This parameter is not supported for PolarDB for MySQL clusters.

To view the valid values for this parameter, log on to the PolarDB console, go to the Configuration and Management > Database Management tab, and click Create Database
Ctype.description_zh:
语言环境设置，用于指定数据库的字符分类。

语言环境必须与CharacterSetName参数设置的字符集兼容。
与Collate传入信息一致。
当集群为PolarDB PostgreSQL版（兼容Oracle）或PolarDB PostgreSQL版时，该参数必填；当集群为PolarDB MySQL版时，不支持该参数。

关于该参数的取值范围，请登录PolarDB控制台，在配置与管理 > 数据库管理页签，单击创建数据库进行查看
